name: sprint41_volspike_drift_spy_v3_loader_gated
hypothesis: Volume-spike-conditioned drift on SPY 1m RTH bars. Crypto volspike was closed on 3 universes (sprint03/04/26); equity RTH microstructure with an institutional close-auction and news-driven volume regime is a distinct mechanism, and sprint38/39 never scored (n=0, data defect, not evidence).
power_argument: SPY 30m stdev ~20bp; SE at n=300 ~1.15bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~2.3bp gross-of-nothing; PASS needs net-of-T2 t>=2 so gross must exceed ~28bp. 1 symbol x ~63 validation RTH days x cap10/day = up to 630 entries, clears the 300 floor. Null criteria can fail: random-entry C0 on the same loader must show net ~-26bp.
prerequisite: HELD -- data.py Alpaca IEX 1m RTH loader; re-run C0/C1 on the new loader before scoring.
